verdict.rationale: RingCentral's developer docs describe registering an app and creating auth credentials for it, with scopes (permissions) declared per application in the Developer Console and confirmed by the user at authorization. Restricted scopes require a support-reviewed justification, so a dedicated agent app can be limited to only the scopes it needs. Missing for 10: agent-specific credential guidance, evidence of token expiry/rotation/revocation controls, finer-than-scope resource restrictions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
